conditions: Assumption 1: stationary PSD kernel bounded by kappa >= 1

source.label: cor:unif_to_regret
source.quote: The following holds for the plug-in maximization algorithm $\mathscr A$ that estimates $f$ on $\Xs^\circ$ with KRR. With probability at least $1-\delta$, $$r_n^{\mathscr A}\lesssim \left(R\sqrt{\frac{\log(2|\Xs^\circ|/\delta)}{n\tau}}+\|\fwithin\|_{\Hs}\right)\max_{x\in \Xs^\circ}\sigma_{\bm x,\tau}(x) +\Lambda(\mathsf{P}_{\tau})\varepsilon.$$

results.notes: Combined with Cor. 5 / Thm 15 Lebesgue constant bounds, Lambda_P <= sqrt(d_eff) generically, O(log(e+kappa/tau)) for 1D monotone spectra with log spectral Lebesgue growth, O_m(log^{2m-1}(e+kappa^m/tau)) for Fourier-diagonal product kernels; these Lebesgue bounds are not themselves regret statements and are not recorded separately.

symbols.alpha_dec: subdomain eigendecay exponent alpha in D2+ (mu_i <= C_3 rho^alpha i^{-s} on cubes of side rho)

conditions: kernel satisfies polynomial eigendecay on subdomains (D2+) and bounded eigenfunctions on subdomains (D3)

source.label: thm:regretbound
source.quote: Consider the online model of \cref{def:online} on $[-1,1]^m$. Under \cref{ass:valboundisoker}, let $\fwithin\in\Hs$ satisfy $\|\fwithin\|_\Hs\le B$ and $\|f-\fwithin\|_\infty\le\varepsilon$, and suppose the kernel satisfies $\defpolysub$ and $\defbounded$. Then running \cref{alg:pigpucb} with parameters $\lambda = 1$ and $b=\alpha$ yields, with probability at least $1-\delta$, a regret bound of order $$R_n^\mathscr{A}\le \widetilde \Os\left(n^\frac{2m+\alpha}{2m+2\alpha}+n\varepsilon\right).$$

results.notes: Paper notes this equals O_tilde(sqrt(gamma_n n) + n eps) since gamma_n = Theta_tilde(n^{m/(m+alpha)}). Regret is realized cumulative regret f(x*)-f(x_t) with probability 1-delta. Algorithm uses eps and B in its bonus.

cited_results.setting_description: Misspecified kernelized bandit, cumulative regret, sup-norm misspecification eps
